description: Tief eingeschnittener, staubiger Feldweg zwischen warmbraunen Erdböschungen, sattgrünen Sträuchern und sommergoldenem Gras. Der Weg führt von der Wiese oben links in einer weiten Biegung zur Öffnung rechts; ein kleines Hofdach ist am fernen rechten Rand angedeutet.
notes: Verbindliche Stil-, Paletten-, Licht- und Perspektivreferenz: output/imagegen/raw/bg-lia-meadow/bg-lia-meadow.png.
Romanquelle sources/novel/roman-selantis-2.txt, PDF-Seiten 6 bis 13; konkrete Beschreibung von Hohlweg, Bodenwärme, Erdhügeln, Sträuchern und fernem Hof auf Seiten 12 bis 13.
Begehbarer Bereich ist ausschließlich der durchgehende Weg. Bewachsene Erdwände begrenzen ihn beidseitig. Keine Kollisionsdaten implementiert.
Wegeanschlüsse: oberer Bildrand im linken Bereich, ungefähr x=0.12 bis 0.16; rechter Bildrand ungefähr y=0.40 bis 0.46. Normierte Koordinaten, Ursprung links oben. Keine weiteren Wegeausgänge.
Rohbild 1672 × 941 px wie die Wiesenreferenz, annähernd 16:9; Ziel 640 × 360 über die spätere Projektpipeline, hier keine Skalierung oder Quantisierung.
Generiert mit eingebautem image_gen-Tool. Zweiter Versuch korrigiert gezielt den Anschluss an den oberen Bildrand.

prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: empty playable background map for Selantis pixel RPG, map-hohlweg. Generate a new adjacent screen of the exact world depicted in the supplied meadow reference. Reference image is a STYLE, PIXEL DENSITY, PALETTE, LIGHTING AND CAMERA reference only, not a scene to reproduce. Match its crisp pixel clusters, dark contours, earthy saturated greens, golden summer vegetation, elevated three-quarter overhead camera, material rendering and object scale.

Scene: A sunken rural dirt lane, a Hohlweg deeply worn into soil by generations of regular use. A continuous wide dusty foot-and-cart path is flanked on BOTH sides by clearly raised earthen banks with exposed warm brown soil faces, small stones, a few roots and dense leafy shrubs on their crowns. The raised banks must be visually readable impassable boundaries and cast sharp long shadows across parts of the path. Golden dry grasses and occasional small white flowers on the banks match the meadow reference. Warm sun-baked dry soil, no water or mud.

CRITICAL route composition: exactly TWO path exits. Entrance at the TOP edge near the UPPER LEFT corner (center x about 12% of image width), visibly descending from a high grassy meadow down a bank into the sunken lane. From there the path descends diagonally towards the middle-left, bends gently through the central screen, then heads toward and exits the RIGHT image border at MIDDLE HEIGHT (center y about 50%). The lane is a continuous unobstructed walkable corridor, broad enough for RPG characters, clearly separated from unwalkable banks all along. NO path at bottom edge, NO third exit, NO branching. The lower foreground is filled by the near earthen bank with shrubs and grasses. On the right the lane emerges from the banks into a small opening. At the extreme far right, above the opening, only a very small distant subdued sliver of a plain farmhouse roof may peek through vegetation, suggesting the farm ahead. No large building, no full farm scene.

Camera: fixed elevated 3/4 top-down view, same as reference, terrain ground plane dominates, no cinematic low angle, no sweeping horizon, no vanishing-point depth. Same pixel density and same shrub/grass scale as reference, consistent pixel size throughout.
Light: low late summer evening sun from UPPER RIGHT, golden light on top/right surfaces and long cast shadows extending LOWER LEFT. Palette anchors summer gold #D6AD59 and rich green #52783C, warm tan dust and exposed earth, very dark green shadows, just like reference.
Output: 16:9 LANDSCAPE, opaque full-frame background.
STRICT empty stage: NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO HUD, NO interface, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO heraldry, NO banners, NO crests, NO runes, NO magic, NO castle, NO watermark. No photorealistic texture, soft gradients, bloom or painterly blur.
Save generated output in /Users/logge/Documents/Projects/SelantisRPG/output/imagegen/raw/map-hohlweg/ if the tool supports saving; do not write into other project paths.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Selantis Hohlweg background with ONE targeted correction: connect the existing upper-left dirt-lane entrance continuously to the TOP image edge. At x approximately 12% of width, extend the existing path from its current upper-left start all the way to y=0. Remove just the small obstructing strip of grass/foliage there to reveal a tan dirt ramp descending from the meadow into the sunken lane. The TOP BORDER must be visibly intersected by dusty path over a width of approximately 5-7% of image width, centered at x12%. The entrance must not terminate inside the image or be concealed behind a tree. Keep the two earth banks flanking this ramp.
Preserve ALL other scene elements and composition exactly: current continuous winding sunken route, clear earthen boundaries on both sides, path exiting RIGHT edge at middle height, foreground shrubs and golden grass, subtle distant roof at extreme upper right, crispy pixel density and contours, elevated 3/4 top-down camera, summer gold #D6AD59 and saturated green #52783C, evening sunlight from upper right with shadows toward lower left. Same 16:9 landscape format. No third path exit, no path at bottom. Empty stage, absolutely no figures, animals, HUD, text, emblems, heraldry, magical effects, watermark. Output path if supported: /Users/logge/Documents/Projects/SelantisRPG/output/imagegen/raw/map-hohlweg/.

self_review.style: Crispe Pixelcluster, dunkle Konturen, Vegetationsmaßstab und erhöhte 3/4-Draufsicht passen zur verbindlichen Wiesenreferenz.
self_review.palette_and_light: Sommergold und sattes Grün dominieren. Licht kommt von oben rechts; Strauch- und Böschungsschatten liegen nach links unten auf dem warmen Weg. Hex-Anker wurden vorgegeben, keine exakte Farbpixelmessung.
self_review.composition: Kontinuierlicher freier Weg mit sichtbarem Eintritt oben links am oberen Rand und Austritt rechts auf mittlerer Höhe. Beidseitige Erdwände und Strauchkronen sind als Grenzen lesbar.
self_review.distant_farm: Kleine Dachspitze am äußersten rechten oberen Rand; bleibt Hintergrundandeutung.
self_review.empty_stage: Keine Figuren, Tiere, HUD, Texte, Wappen, Runen, Burg oder Magie sichtbar.
limitations: Rohformat weicht minimal vom mathematisch exakten Verhältnis 16:9 ab und entspricht der Referenzauflösung.
Weganschlüsse sind visuelle Näherungsangaben; spielbare Kollisionen wurden nicht geprüft.
